name: NTPC Green Energy Ltd
about: Incorporated in April 2022, NTPC Green Energy is a renewable energy company that focuses on undertaking projects through organic and inorganic routes.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL) is a renewable energy subsidiary of NTPC Limited, a central public sector enterprise. As of September 30, 2024, NGEL is the largest renewable energy public sector enterprise in India (excluding hydro). Their business model centers on development, construction, and operation of renewable energy projects (solar and wind), supported by long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).
